about_short_description.short_description: Kuwait Finance House is considered a pioneer in the banking phenomenon known as Islamic Finance or Shari’a Compliant Banking.

product.name: Personal Banking
product.description: Sharia-compliant retail banking services covering accounts, cards, financing, investments, payment services, and customer support for individuals.

product.name: Islamic Financing
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for housing, consumer purchases, collateral-backed needs, debt restructuring, and other personal requirements.

product.name: KFH Auto
product.description: Vehicle and equipment financing and leasing for cars, marine equipment, motorcycles, and other products, including operating and finance lease options.

product.name: Banking Cards
product.description: Debit, credit, and prepaid cards for domestic and international payments, with card-management, rewards, and related support services.

product.name: KFHOnline Digital Banking
product.description: Digital banking through web and mobile channels for transfers, account and deposit opening, virtual cards, gold transactions, cardless cash services, and money requests.

product.name: Investment Services
product.description: Islamic investment deposits and long-term investment plans for customers seeking savings and investment solutions based on Sharia-compliant structures.
